_comment: REQUIRED, not redundant with the repo-root .mcp.json. Verified 2026-08-25: with the repo mounted as a Cowork context folder, the repo-root .mcp.json produced no Playwright tools at all. Cowork does not read project-level .mcp.json; a plugin-bundled server is the only way it gets one. The repo copy serves Claude Code sessions rooted here. Keep the version pin identical in both. --output-dir is load-bearing: the server allows file uploads only from its output dir and its cwd, and Cowork spawns it with cwd=C:\Windows\System32, so without this the repo's own staged PDFs are rejected as "outside allowed roots". It also lets browser_evaluate write form-inventory manifests straight into the repo instead of through an agent's context.
